changelog:
Initial release: Huawei Cloud ICP Filing Rule Consultation Skill.

- Provides read-only consultation on ICP filing rules for Huawei Cloud, focusing on process, required materials, entity/account limits, and filing types (change, access, cancellation, migration, APP).
- Responds only to explicit user mentions of ICP filing-related keywords; refuses non-ICP topics like domain registration or pricing.
- Uses embedded Q&A knowledge base as primary source; fetches official documentation or searches Huawei Cloud site as fallback.
- Two built-in, Python-based tools: web_fetcher (for direct document retrieval) and web_searcher (for site search using Playwright).
- No operations or filings performed on behalf of users; information only.
- Designed for after-sales technical engineers handling mainland China non-commercial internet information service filings.
